note: P1, P2 and P4 are close relatives: bottom-right dark card or pill that expands into a multi-package list with per-row progress, timeline and Next/Remove actions, and P2 and P4 are nearly the same pill-to-list pattern; only P3 (All/Active/Delivered tabs, horizontal stepper, teal accent) departs. Q varies more in placement (Q2 sits top-right, the rest bottom-right) and in information structure (single-parcel timeline with Show history in Q3, Keep open in Q4, a page-list plus vertical timeline in Q2), though Q1 and Q3 repeat the same bottom-right 'Handed to the carrier 3 of 5' pill and timeline.
